**Public-data safety checklist**

- Do not attach raw debug logs, crash dumps, result files, catalog databases,
  action plans, quarantine journals, settings directories, or private media.
  These files can contain full paths, network locations, metadata, file names,
  command text, or process memory.
- Prefer redacted structured diagnostics when available. Inspect every line
  before posting and replace user names, host names, volume labels, shares,
  and file paths with stable placeholders.
- Redact screenshots too, including window titles, thumbnails, EXIF data, and
  path columns. Do not post credentials, tokens, cookies, private keys, or
  environment files.
- If this may permit arbitrary deletion, command execution, privilege
  escalation, or private-data exposure, stop and follow
  [the security policy](https://github.com/AiWithYou/dupeguru_neo/security/policy).
  Do not disclose it in a public issue, discussion, pull request, log, or
  attachment.
